# Visit Toronto Tours by Travaza

> Toronto tours, Toronto walking tours, audio guided tours, seasonal tours and scavenger hunt tours. Things to do in Toronto, plus the Backstreets Back fan-themed city tour (coming soon).

Website: https://visittorontotours.com/
Email: reservations@travaza.com
Phone: +1 866 979 1181
Bookable tours are operated by Gray Line Toronto/Niagara Falls Canada; booking is online.

## Bookable now
- From Toronto: Small Group City Tour
- Toronto Distillery Winter Market Shuttle
- Toronto's Winter Lights & Scavenger Hunt by Bus
